title: How assessors score your submission
body: Proposed pass rule: Proposed: ≥80/100 and every critical gate Passed; all dimensions must be scored.

table.caption: Capstone rubric (proposed, 100 points)
head: ID
Dimension
Points
Required evidence
Full-credit anchor
Insufficient anchor
rows: Clear hypothesis tied to scenario evidence; all critical roles and go/narrow logic included.
Generic pitch, unsupported customer facts or no readiness review.
Outcome-led, non-leading, captures evidence and obtains next-step agreement.
Product tour or unbounded brainstorming with no customer evidence.
Priorities defensible; business/technical owners, dependencies and metric plan present.
All ideas marked quick wins or major blockers ignored.
Two detailed traceable maps with no unit confusion and honest gaps.
Missing map, invented baseline or conflated wait and labor.
Two feasible hypothesis maps; retained controls and reviewed corrections.
Unsupported automation, removed essential controls or hidden access risks.
All material assumptions traceable; downside visible; benefit type and sensitivity explained.
Material formula/unit error, guaranteed ROI, invented evidence or capacity claimed as cash.
Concise decision-led narrative, credible challenge handling and conditional decisions captured.
Generic demo, misleading claims or no decision request.
Recommendation fits unresolved question; stop rules and agreed/proposed dates clear.
Unqualified pilot promise, absent criteria or no accountable action plan.
Complete versioned manifest, risks/exclusions and source/AI review record.
Core artifacts missing, confidential data exposed or AI treated as approver.
